exposure: Season of birth (winter and autumn births)
outcome: Atopic dermatitis (occurrence, age at onset, anatomical location, severity)
cohort: The study followed 150 preterm and 300 term newborns during their first year of life.
finding: Atopic dermatitis during the first year of life was observed in 21.2% of children, being more common, severe, and with an earlier age of onset in term children compared with preterm children.
